other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a resident of Meghalaya
The beneficiary must be engaged in building or other construction work
The beneficiary must be registered under the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWWB)
The beneficiary must have an active membership of the Board
The beneficiary must be permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, tuberculosis (T.B.), accidents, or similar conditions
benefits_summary: A disability pension of ₹150 per month plus a possible ex‑gratia payment of up to ₹5,000 depending on the percentage of disability.
